_meta.status: written by an AI for catalogue/tutorial.toml, not yet reviewed by the owner
_meta.keys: tutorials: Pandaborn.Tutorial.<tutorial id> (the tutorial's name); stages: Pandaborn.Tutorial.<stage id> (the stage's intro). Step texts are the game's own.
_meta.style: Vanilla tutorial intros are one or two short sentences that say why, not how (the step line says how).

stages.PandabornTutorial.Water: Every village starts at the water. A Water Pump fills the stores with clean water.
stages.PandabornTutorial.Gatherer: Gatherers pick wild food until the first fields are ready.
stages.PandabornTutorial.ShootBamboo: Shoot bamboo is the first crop: a Farmhouse plants it on moist ground, and its shoots are ready in three days.
stages.PandabornTutorial.Lumberjack: Lumberjacks cut trees for logs, and timber bamboo for poles.
stages.PandabornTutorial.PoleMill: Until the first bamboo has grown, a Pole Mill splits logs into poles. It needs power: a Power Wheel will do.
stages.PandabornTutorial.TimberBamboo: Timber bamboo is cut straight into poles, with no mill. A Forester plants it; it is ready within a week.
stages.PandabornTutorial.Dens: A Den houses a small family. Finish two before the village grows.
stages.PandabornTutorial.Steamer: Steamed shoots fill a villager better than raw ones and bring their own wellbeing.
stages.PandabornTutorial.Hammock: Afternoons are for naps. A Hammock gives one villager a nap in the sun.
stages.PandabornTutorial.Bell: Inkpaws work a short day and work it well. With a twelve-hour day, they work and walk a third faster.
stages.PandabornTutorial.ScoopWheel: A Scoop Wheel sits in a current and lifts water into a flume.
stages.PandabornTutorial.Flume: Flumes carry water downhill, one way, to fields and groves far from the river.
stages.PandabornTutorial.MoonLoft: Your first Moon Loft invites a Ringtail family. Ringtails work from the afternoon bell to dawn.
stages.PandabornTutorial.FirstShoots: A good store of shoots carries the village through the first dry days.
stages.PandabornTutorial.FirstPoles: Poles build almost everything. Gather a stock before the big buildings.
stages.PandabornTutorial.TeaGarden: Tea grows on dry ground, away from the wet fields. The Forester plants it and gatherers pick it.
stages.PandabornTutorial.Roastery: A Tea Roastery roasts the picked leaves into tea that keeps.
stages.PandabornTutorial.Tea: Roasted tea waits in the warehouse until the Teahouse calls for it.
stages.PandabornTutorial.Teahouse: Tea is drunk at the Teahouse, nowhere else. It serves roasted tea and water to villagers off duty.
